plugins.name: voicenter-api
plugins.description: 16 skills covering all 14 Voicenter APIs: VoiceBot, Click2Call, Pop-Up Screen, CDR Notification, External Layer, Call Log, Blacklist, Mute Recording, Extension List, Real-Time, Productive Dialer, Login/Logout, Lead Tracker, Active Calls — plus a GetCallHistory AI-enrichment skill and a CRM-onboarding scoping playbook.

skills.name: active-calls
skills.description: Get a real-time snapshot of all active calls and queue activity via the Voicenter Active Calls API

skills.name: blacklist
skills.description: Add or remove phone numbers from the Voicenter organization blacklist

skills.name: call-log
skills.description: Pull call detail records (CDR) from Voicenter using the Call Log API
headings: The server making requests must also have its IP authorized in Voicenter CPanel

skills.name: cdr-notification
skills.description: Receive and handle CDR push notifications from Voicenter after every call ends
headings: No outbound API token needed — Voicenter sends requests TO your server.
Configure your webhook URL in: Voicenter CPanel → Integrations → CDR Notification

skills.name: click2call
skills.description: Initiate or terminate outgoing calls using the Voicenter Click2Call API
headings: The server's IP must be authorized in Voicenter CPanel

skills.name: crm-onboarding
skills.description: CRM integration scoping & onboarding playbook. Use when scoping a NEW CRM integration, running a discovery/feasibility/spec meeting, or choosing between API vs Chrome extension vs local BAT, Push vs Pull, and CRM-owned vs Voicenter-owned screen pop. Covers: CRM type detection (on-premise vs web), entity/field mapping, Click2Call station-code setup, screen pop architecture (who owns it), trigger-stage rules (ring/answer/hangup), call history method (CDR Push vs Call Log Pull), and full decision checklist. Trigger on: new CRM, CRM onboarding, integration spec, feasibility, station code, screen pop ownership, on-premise vs web CRM, Push vs Pull.
headings: STEP 0 — CRM type: the first question ⭐
KEY DECISION: who owns the pop? ⭐

skills.name: extension-list
skills.description: Retrieve the full list of active extensions and users in a Voicenter organization

skills.name: external-layer
skills.description: Build an External Layer IVR endpoint that lets Voicenter route inbound calls based on your CRM business logic
headings: No outbound API token needed — Voicenter sends requests TO your server.
Configure your endpoint URL in: Voicenter CPanel → Incoming → IVR → select layer → Layer Settings → "Allow mini external IVR"
GO_TO_LAYER — Route to a Voicenter IVR layer
SAY_DIGITS — Announce dynamic data then route
DIAL — Call an external phone number or extension directly
Error Response — triggers configured fallback layer

skills.name: get-call-history
skills.description: Pull specific call data by CallID with AI analysis — summary, emotions, personality traits, and insights. Does NOT include full transcription (CDR Notification only). Use for on-demand AI enrichment, CRM quality reviews, and retroactive summary retrieval via the two-step Call Log → GetCallHistory flow.
headings: Note: this API uses Bearer [已隐藏] auth — NOT the 'code' param used by other Voicenter APIs
You need both VOICENTER_BEARER_TOKEN (for GetCallHistory) and VOICENTER_API_CODE (for Call Log)
if you are implementing the two-step retroactive lookup flow.

skills.name: lead-tracker
skills.description: Track which marketing campaign or web page generated an inbound call using the Voicenter Lead Tracker JS SDK
headings: Token is provided by Voicenter and is tied to a pool of DIDs configured for your account
Replace phone number text + click-to-call button
Pass UTM and click ID parameters
Get the DID programmatically (no DOM update)
How visitor data appears in CDR

skills.name: login-logout
skills.description: Set agent login/logout and status via the Voicenter Login/Logout API

skills.name: mute-recording
skills.description: Mute or unmute call recording in real time via the Voicenter Mute Call Recording API
headings: Replace "monitor1" with your account's actual monitor server.
Get the dynamic server from the Real-Time API connection URL, or contact Voicenter support.

skills.name: popup-screen
skills.description: Implement a Pop-Up Screen endpoint that Voicenter calls during incoming calls to display caller CRM data to agents
headings: No outbound API token needed — Voicenter sends requests TO your server.
Configure your endpoint URL in: Voicenter CPanel → Extension settings or DID settings → "Pop-Up Screen URL"
The Voicenter Chrome Extension must be installed on the agent's browser for the popup to appear.

skills.name: productive-dialer
skills.description: Manage auto-dialer campaigns via the Voicenter Dialer API — add/remove destinations, control campaigns, manage agents

skills.name: real-time
skills.description: Connect to Voicenter real-time call and agent events via the EventsSDK (socket.io)
headings: Token type depends on your login method:
`QueueEvent` — Call enters or exits a queue
`ExtensionEvent` — Call lifecycle and agent status changes

skills.name: voicebot
skills.description: Build a VoiceBot data endpoint that the Voicenter Voice Agent calls mid-conversation to fetch dynamic CRM data
headings: No outbound API token needed — Voicenter sends requests TO your server.
Configure your endpoint URL in: Voice Agent intent settings → "URL" field under "תגובה" (Response)
Response with a list (e.g., open orders)
